name: Shirosaki Mieru
source: Mieru is a genius in making sweets and also is the top of the school in the exams. She is also the daughter of the academy's director. She is also lazy as she finishes making the sweets for the class or she skips classes.
translation: Mieru is a genius in making sweets and also is the top of the school in the exams. She is also the daughter of the academy's director. She is also lazy as she finishes making the sweets for the class or she skips classes.
